test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2024: Official Paper (Held On: 08 Jul, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
What would be the symbol on the opposite side of '@' if the given sheet is folded to form a cube?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a453efa9bde263e6d05ec90e5e960c0b9ceddeb10e8682bc2b607480d6307bc3.png]
solution:
From the given open Dice:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a0dc43345ed6047519bc47b4c80d03da8e2b54d2763bbd5634b3e7ae59a5f49f.png] 

$ and % is the opposite sides.

^ and # is the opposite sides.

**@ and * is the opposite sides.**

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 2".**
